GOTO base rate (100%) °/s
Changes the base of the 5 GOTO speeds (50–200%) (:SX94). Saved in the mount and kept after power off. Setting it returns the GOTO speed to 100%.
The firmware limits it so that 200% does not exceed the maximum step rate (then the value becomes slower than entered). Cannot be changed during a GOTO.
When this page opens and the OnStep date and time are not set, this device’s clock is sent automatically (without the date and time after power-on, unpark and GOTO are refused).
Mechanical settings (steps/degree, microsteps, reversal) take effect after a power cycle (restart).
